card.name: Section cross-reference brackets in drug labels
card.fires_on: Punctuation inside label cross-references, mainly the closing parenthesis after a section number like (6.1, and the hyphen in P-450. Also fires on single letters partway through long drug-interaction words like tricyclic or contraindicated.

modes.label: Section cross-reference bracket
modes.description: The closing parenthesis right after a section number in an 'Adverse Reactions (6.1)' style reference.

modes.label: Inside drug-interaction terms
modes.description: A hyphen or single letter inside enzyme names or long words such as cytochrome P-450, tricyclic, contraindicated.
